translations.web: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.
translations.bsb: They sacrificed to demons, not to God, to gods they had not known, to newly arrived gods, which your fathers did not fear.
